audienceSection.headline: The numbers behind the storytelling.
audienceSection.noteTemplate: Over the last 90 days, this account generated {views90d} views — 76.3% of them from non-followers. That is the signature of content built for reach, not just retention.

demographics.whyThisMatters: A 25–34-led audience, over half the total, sits squarely in the primary decision-making demographic for premium travel, hospitality and technology purchases — high-value viewers, not just high-volume ones.

performance.label: Non-Follower Views
performance.description: Content surfacing to new audiences via Explore and Reels.

performance.description: Early-stage funnel — headroom for future campaign links.

notes.title: 76.3% Non-Follower Views
notes.description: Most views come from outside the existing follower base — evidence of algorithmic distribution, not just retention.

notes.title: Reels-Led Distribution
notes.description: Reels account for the large majority of the 90-day view total, ahead of Stories and static posts.

notes.title: Reach Over Retention
notes.description: Growth is currently discovery-led — an ideal stage for a brand to enter early and be part of the story.

topReel.insight: The best-performing single piece of content in this window drew roughly 59,000 views on its own — well beyond the current follower count.

previousResults.note: Every figure on this page is drawn directly from Instagram's own Insights dashboard — nothing extrapolated or projected. Reporting window: 11 May – 7 Aug 2026.
